s4_k4_applications.statement: The K4/FCC action has 12 unordered diamonds and 24 ordered witness orientations; unordered stabilizer is C2 and ordered action is regular.
The 24->12 ordered-witness cover has no S4-equivariant section because the C2 stabilizer has no fixed lift.
For X_h=D_12 x Q_h the graded first-return kernel commutes with S4; the scalar counter survives the signed-orientation no-section obstruction.

agm_domain_results.statement: The completed positive first-return mass F reconstructs the geometric channel b+=H(1-F)/2 with (b+)^2=ab, gives F=2*chord_loss, and exact next shape F/(2-F).
For 0<s<=1/4 and every N>=1, s^2/4 <= T_N(s) < (256/961)s^2 and T_N(s)/s^2 -> 1/4; one shell already preserves the quadratic class.
On the standard AGM orbit a sufficient p-bit inner depth is max(1,ceil(p/[2(3*2^n-2)])-1), with K4/S4 scalar state cost 24N+12.
A pure-integer two-index interval compiler certifies a 546-bit-wide endogenous completion bracket under the frozen six-step schedule.
Four exact outer AGM steps cannot certify a 256-bit completion bracket under the accepted completion bracket; at least five are necessary.
Within the frozen B=640 compiler/cost envelope the five-step depth optima are (50,18,8,3,1) for width and (51,18,8,3,1) for a common 256-bit cell.
